articles.summary: SINGAPORE, Aug. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Amber International Holding Limited (Nasdaq: AMBR), today announced that it will release its unaudited financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, before the U.S. market opens on Thursday, September 3, 2026.
articles.title: Amber International Holding Limited to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Host Earnings Call on September 3, 2026
